thread:
alex: Heads-up: SIEM group 'cross-tenant-access' fired ~700 alerts in 10m. Most look like infra deploy AssumeRole calls. :eyes:
sec-bot: Alert group TG-2026-432 created: https://siem.company/alerts/TG-2026-432 (rule: cross-tenant-assume-role). Count: 701
priya: I see the same. Our scheduled key rotation job did a mass AssumeRole to clone infra across accounts — expected behavior.
kevin: Can we verify these were all from the deploy-service principal? I can run a query.
alex: Quick lookup: `source:cloudtrail eventName=AssumeRole userIdentity.arn=arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/deploy-service/* | stats count by sourceIPAddress, userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName`
alex: Results show a single service principal, two IP blocks.
jordan: Is the rule scoped to any AssumeRole or only cross-account? If it's any, that's noisy for us.
priya: Rule currently triggers when externalAccountId != home account. We neglected to whitelist our deploy workflow that does cross-account orchestrations.
kevin: Proposed immediate fixes: 1) add allowlist for deploy-service principal, 2) raise threshold to 50 events / 5m per principal, 3) enrich with KMS usage so we don't suppress high-risk cases.
alex: Agree. Also correlate with KMS:Decrypt — a lot of those sessions performed Decrypt. Don't want to blind ourselves.
priya: Suggest rule change: require cross-account AssumeRole AND (ConsoleLogin OR KMS:Decrypt within 10m) to fire, otherwise suppress. That should cut noise.
jordan: Good. Also add `source=deploy` tag when principal matches deploy pattern so dashboards can filter.
kevin: I'll update detection config and push to staging. Will add a temporary suppression window to avoid alert storm.
sec-bot: Deploy started for rule update: ci/build/siem-detections@rule-345 -> staging
alex: Can we add a dashboard panel: "AssumeRole by principal" with KMS activity overlay to speed triage?
priya: I'll make a saved search: `eventName=AssumeRole | join (eventName=Decrypt) by sessionContext.sessionId` and add to dashboards/deployment-ops.
kevin: Pushed change to staging. New rule: require cross-account AND (KMSDecrypt OR ConsoleLogin) OR when count > 50/5m. Added allowlist for `arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/deploy-service/*`.
kevin: Also added metadata tag `noisy:deploy` for grouping and suppression UI.
alex: After staging run, alerts dropped to 9 in 1h. Good sign. :thumbsup:
jordan: Post-incident actions: update runbook, add RBAC note about scheduled cross-account rotates, schedule a short onboarding for infra team.
priya: I'll open a postmortem with action items and link to the ticket.
priya: Action items: 1) update detection rule (kevin) 2) dashboard (priya) 3) runbook update (jordan) 4) KMS audit integration checklist (security eng) 5) retro with infra (all).
kevin: ETA for prod deploy: today EOD after QA.
alex: Also add a metric for "alerts suppressed" and surface it on the security dashboard for 30d.
jordan: Can we add a regression alert if suppressed counts spike? To catch misconfig errors.
kevin: Will add a threshold alert: suppressed_count > 100/day -> notify #sec-oncall.
sec-bot: Rule update promoted to prod: rule-345 (version 2) by kevin_m. Timestamp 1763104945
alex: Closing thread once postmortem ticket created.
priya: Postmortem created: https://tickets.company/INC-2026-78 (assignee: priya)
alex: Thanks all. :rocket:
